verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י׀ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֗ים וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית אֲבִינָדָ֖ב בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וְאֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֤ר בְּנוֹ֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּ לִשְׁמֹ֖ר אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’an·šê qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm way·ya·‘ă·lū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- bêṯ ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ bag·giḇ·‘āh wə·’eṯ- ’el·‘ā·zār bə·nōw qid·də·šū liš·mōr ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the men of Kiriath-jearim came for the ark of the LORD and took - it into Abinadab’s house on the hill And they consecrated his son Eleazar to guard the ark of the LORD
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO vieram os homens de Quiriate-Jearim, e levaram a arca do SENHOR, e a trouxeram à casa de Abinadabe, no outeiro; e consagraram a Eleazar, seu filho, para que guardasse a arca do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִיּ֞וֹם שֶׁ֤בֶת הָֽאָרוֹן֙ בְּקִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים וַיִּרְבּוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיִּנָּה֛וּ כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî mî·yō·wm še·ḇeṯ hā·’ā·rō·wn bə·qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm way·yir·bū hay·yā·mîm way·yih·yū ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh way·yin·nā·hū kāl- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And from that day a long time passed twenty years in all as the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim And all the house of Israel mournfully sought the LORD
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, desde aquele dia, a arca ficou em Quiriate-Jearim, e tantos dias se passaram que até chegaram vinte anos, e lamentava toda a casa de Israel pelo SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֶל־ כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִם־ בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם שָׁבִים֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה הָסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֧י הַנֵּכָ֛ר מִתּוֹכְכֶ֖ם וְהָעַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְהָכִ֨ינוּ לְבַבְכֶ֤ם אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ וְעִבְדֻ֣הוּ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְיַצֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- kāl- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ’im- bə·ḵāl lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’at·tem šā·ḇîm ’el- Yah·weh hā·sî·rū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê han·nê·ḵār mit·tō·wḵ·ḵem wə·hā·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ wə·hā·ḵî·nū lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’el- Yah·weh wə·‘iḇ·ḏu·hū lə·ḇad·dōw wə·yaṣ·ṣêl ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts then put away the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you prepare your hearts for the LORD and serve Him only And He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Então falou Samuel a toda a casa de Israel, dizendo: Se com todo o vosso coração vos converterdes ao SENHOR, tirai dentre vós os deuses estranhos e os astarotes, e preparai o vosso coração ao SENHOR, e servi a ele só, e vos livrará da mão dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיָּסִ֙ירוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הָעַשְׁתָּרֹ֑ת וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sî·rū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ā·lîm wə·’eṯ- hā·‘aš·tā·rōṯ way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh lə·ḇad·dōw
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então os filhos de Israel tiraram dentre si aos baalins e aos astarotes, e serviram só ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל קִבְצ֥וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַמִּצְפָּ֑תָה וְאֶתְפַּלֵּ֥ל בַּעַדְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl qiḇ·ṣū ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl ham·miṣ·pā·ṯāh wə·’eṯ·pal·lêl ba·‘aḏ·ḵem ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Samuel said Gather all Israel to Mizpah and I will pray to the LORD on your behalf
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Samuel: Congregai a todo o Israel em Mizpá; e orarei por vós ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ הַ֠מִּצְפָּתָה וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־ מַ֜יִם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכ֣וּ׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּצ֙וּמוּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ שָׁ֔ם חָטָ֖אנוּ לַיהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֧ט שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ham·miṣ·pā·ṯāh way·yiš·’ă·ḇū- ma·yim way·yiš·pə·ḵū lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yā·ṣū·mū bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yō·mə·rū šām ḥā·ṭā·nū Yah·weh way·yiš·pōṭ šə·mū·’êl ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bam·miṣ·pāh
verses.literal: When they had gathered at Mizpah they drew water and poured it out before the LORD On that day they fasted and there they confessed We have sinned against the LORD And Samuel judged the Israelites . . . at Mizpah
verses.literalPt: E congregaram-se em Mizpá, e tiraram água, e a derramaram perante o SENHOR, e jejuaram aquele dia, e disseram ali: Pecamos contra o SENHOR. E julgava Samuel os filhos de Israel em Mizpá.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּֽי־ הִתְקַבְּצ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַמִּצְפָּ֔תָה וַיַּעֲל֥וּ סַרְנֵֽי־ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּֽרְא֖וּ מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū p̄ə·liš·tîm kî- hiṯ·qab·bə·ṣū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ham·miṣ·pā·ṯāh way·ya·‘ă·lū sar·nê- p̄ə·liš·tîm ’el- yiś·rā·’êl way·yiš·mə·‘ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yir·’ū mip·pə·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites . . . had gathered at Mizpah their rulers marched up toward Israel And when the Israelites . . . learned of this they feared . . . the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo, pois, os filisteus que os filhos de Israel estavam congregados em Mizpá, subiram os maiorais dos filisteus contra Israel; o que ouvindo os filhos de Israel, temeram por causa dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל אַל־ תַּחֲרֵ֣שׁ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מִזְּעֹ֖ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵ֖נוּ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- šə·mū·’êl ’al- ta·ḥă·rêš mim·men·nū miz·zə·‘ōq ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·yō·ši·‘ê·nū mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: and . . . said to Samuel Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Por isso disseram os filhos de Israel a Samuel: Não cesses de clamar ao SENHOR nosso Deus por nós, para que nos livre da mão dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל טְלֵ֤ה חָלָב֙ אֶחָ֔ד וַיַּעֲלֶה עוֹלָ֛ה כָּלִ֖יל לַֽיהוָ֑ה וַיִּזְעַ֨ק שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ בְּעַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ šə·mū·’êl ṭə·lêh ḥā·lāḇ ’e·ḥāḏ way·ya·ʿă·lɛh ‘ō·w·lāh kā·lîl Yah·weh way·yiz·‘aq šə·mū·’êl ’el- Yah·weh bə·‘aḏ yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·nê·hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the LORD He cried out to the LORD on behalf of Israel and the LORD answered him
verses.literalPt: Então tomou Samuel um cordeiro de mama, e sacrificou-o inteiro em holocausto ao SENHOR; e clamou Samuel ao SENHOR por Israel, e o SENHOR lhe deu ouvidos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י שְׁמוּאֵל֙ מַעֲלֶ֣ה הָעוֹלָ֔ה וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים נִגְּשׁ֔וּ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּרְעֵ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה׀ בְּקוֹל־ גָּ֠דוֹל בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֤וּא עַל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ וַיְהֻמֵּ֔ם וַיִּנָּגְפ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî šə·mū·’êl ma·‘ă·leh hā·‘ō·w·lāh ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm nig·gə·šū lam·mil·ḥā·māh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yar·‘êm Yah·weh bə·qō·wl- gā·ḏō·wl bay·yō·wm ha·hū ‘al- pə·liš·tîm way·hum·mêm way·yin·nā·ḡə·p̄ū lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As the Philistines drew near to fight against Israel Samuel was offering up the burnt offering But that day the LORD thundered loudly . . . against the Philistines and threw them into such confusion that they fled before Israel
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, estando Samuel sacrificando o holocausto, os filisteus chegaram à peleja contra Israel; e trovejou o SENHOR aquele dia com grande estrondo sobre os filisteus, e os confundiu de tal modo que foram derrotados diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִן־ הַמִּצְפָּ֔ה וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּכּ֕וּם עַד־ מִתַּ֖חַת לְבֵ֥ית כָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū ’an·šê yiś·rā·’êl min- ham·miṣ·pāh way·yir·də·p̄ū ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm way·yak·kūm ‘aḏ- mit·ta·ḥaṯ lə·ḇêṯ kār
verses.literal: Then the men of Israel charged out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines striking them down all the way to an area below Beth-car
verses.literalPt: E os homens de Israel saíram de Mizpá; e perseguiram os filisteus, e os feriram até abaixo de Bete-Car.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶ֣בֶן אַחַ֗ת וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בֵּֽין־ הַמִּצְפָּה֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַשֵּׁ֔ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמָ֖הּ אֶ֣בֶן הָעָ֑זֶר וַיֹּאמַ֕ר עַד־ הֵ֖נָּה עֲזָרָ֥נוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ šə·mū·’êl ’e·ḇen ’a·ḥaṯ way·yā·śem bên- ham·miṣ·pāh ū·ḇên haš·šên way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·māh ’e·ḇen hā·‘ā·zer way·yō·mar ‘aḏ- hên·nāh ‘ă·zā·rā·nū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Afterward, Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah . . . and Shen He named - it Ebenezer saying Thus far the LORD has helped us
verses.literalPt: Então tomou Samuel uma pedra, e a pôs entre Mizpá e Sem, e chamou-lhe Ebenézer; e disse: Até aqui nos ajudou o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּכָּֽנְעוּ֙ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְלֹא־ יָסְפ֣וּ ע֔וֹד לָב֖וֹא בִּגְב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַתְּהִ֤י יַד־ יְהוָה֙ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yik·kā·nə·‘ū hap·pə·liš·tîm wə·lō- yā·sə·p̄ū ‘ō·wḏ lā·ḇō·w biḡ·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl wat·tə·hî yaḏ- Yah·weh bap·pə·liš·tîm kōl yə·mê šə·mū·’êl
verses.literal: So the Philistines were subdued and they stopped invading the territory of Israel - And the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel
verses.literalPt: Assim os filisteus foram abatidos, e nunca mais vieram aos termos de Israel, porquanto foi a mão do SENHOR contra os filisteus todos os dias de Samuel.

verses.original: וַתָּשֹׁ֣בְנָה הֶעָרִ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָֽקְחוּ־ פְלִשְׁתִּים֩ מֵאֵ֨ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵעֶקְר֣וֹן וְעַד־ גַּ֔ת וְאֶ֨ת־ גְּבוּלָ֔ן הִצִּ֥יל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיְהִ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם בֵּ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבֵ֥ין הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·šō·ḇə·nāh he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer lā·qə·ḥū- p̄ə·liš·tîm mê·’êṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘eq·rō·wn wə·‘aḏ- gaṯ wə·’eṯ- gə·ḇū·lān hiṣ·ṣîl yiś·rā·’êl mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm way·hî šā·lō·wm bên yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇên hā·’ĕ·mō·rî
verses.literal: The cities from Ekron to Gath which the Philistines . . . had taken were restored to Israel who also delivered the surrounding territory from the hand of the Philistines And there was peace between the Israelites . . . and the Amorites
verses.literalPt: E as cidades que os filisteus tinham tomado a Israel foram-lhe restituídas, desde Ecrom até Gate, e até os seus termos Israel arrebatou da mão dos filisteus; e houve paz entre Israel e entre os amorreus.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·pōṭ šə·mū·’êl ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kōl yə·mê ḥay·yāw
verses.literal: So Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life
verses.literalPt: E Samuel julgou a Israel todos os dias da sua vida.

verses.original: וְהָלַ֗ךְ מִדֵּ֤י שָׁנָה֙ בְּשָׁנָ֔ה וְסָבַב֙ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וְהַגִּלְגָּ֖ל וְהַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וְשָׁפַט֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַמְּקוֹמ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·laḵ mid·dê šā·nāh bə·šā·nāh wə·sā·ḇaḇ bêṯ- ’êl wə·hag·gil·gāl wə·ham·miṣ·pāh wə·šā·p̄aṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ kāl- ham·mə·qō·w·mō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Every year . . . he would go on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah judging Israel in all these places
verses.literalPt: E ia de ano em ano, e rodeava a Betel, e a Gilgal, e a Mizpá, e julgava a Israel em todos aqueles lugares.

verses.original: וּתְשֻׁבָת֤וֹ הָרָמָ֙תָה֙ כִּֽי־ שָׁ֣ם בֵּית֔וֹ וְשָׁ֖ם שָׁפָ֣ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽבֶן־ שָׁ֥ם מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·šu·ḇā·ṯōw hā·rā·mā·ṯāh kî- šām bê·ṯōw wə·šām šā·p̄āṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yi·ḇen- šām miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then he would return to Ramah because his home was there and there he judged Israel and built an altar to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porém voltava a Ramá, porque estava ali a sua casa, e ali julgava a Israel; e edificou ali um altar ao SENHOR.
